evidence.quote: EBP courses in Münster are held in German (80 %) and English (20 %).

notes: The application channel for a foreign-diploma applicant is not stated: the page only says 'Submit application via Please check this website.' and gives no platform (uni-assist, VPD, or direct portal), so applicationChannel was left out. The tuition statement 'Tuition fees per semester None' is a programme-page statement and is reported as zero; the separate 'Semester contribution Approx. 300 EUR per semester' is not a tuition fee. The winter-semester application deadline is given without a year; 2027-05-31 was chosen because the DAAD page is labelled 2026/2027, and the human auditor should confirm the cycle. A second supplied page (fh-muenster.de Auslandssemester) contains no facts about this programme beyond its title.
